title: Analysis of Ukrainian nationals entering employment in the UK
text:
Tables include data relating to Ukrainian nationals who had registered for a National Insurance number (NINo) on or after 4 March 2022 and were subsequently paid through PAYE. This predominantly captures those entering the UK through humanitarian visa schemes (Homes for Ukraine, Ukraine Family Scheme and Ukraine Extension Scheme).

 This is an ad-hoc release of management information and does not constitute an Official Statistics or National Statistics release.
